title: 3D-1: driver-seat backrest reshaping experiment (scratch candidates, production unchanged)
body: ## Summary Approved 3D-1 experiment, limited to `GEO_Seat_Front_Driver` and `GEO_Seat_Stitching_Front`. This PR adds the script that builds candidate GLBs, a test and the evidence. **No production GLB, viewer, camera, shader or UI file changes.** Candidates are written to `reports/3d-1/candidates/` (git-ignored) and are not committed. Not a visual sign-off: the owner judges the renders. **What the candidate changes:** the driver backrest outline goes from a "shield" (widest at about 70 % height, sharp taper to a narrow neck) to near-parallel sides with broad rounded shoulders, following Gallery 08 and 30. The bolster crest is 15 % lower. It is a visual reconstruction; no seat dimension was supplied and none is claimed. ![Driver Hero, Warm Stone: production left, candidate right; rows Classic, Diamond, Perforated](https://app.devin.ai/api/presigned_proxy?token=eyJhbGciOiJIUzI1NiIsInR5cCI6IkpXVCJ9..05UEgghfeDcqf-qnEITp2us_mxSmyZ_YcTsp-NAJVBY) **How:** `scripts/experiments/3d-1-driver-seat/build-candidates.mjs` decodes each production GLB, applies one displacement field (`seat-profile.mjs`, `deformBackrest`) to backrest vertices and to the stitches on the backrest, transforms normals and tangents with the field's Jacobian, and re-encodes with the production Draco settings. **Measured (all three treatments):** - Triangles 66,260 before and after (0 of the 4,000 allowed; limit 80,000). Draw calls 24. No new primitive or material. - Size: classic 3,651,324 B, diamond 3,787,788 B, perforated 3,510,324 B (each +560 B; limit 5 MB). - `validate-glb.mjs` passes on all three. `compare-glb.mjs` shows geometry differences only in `GEO_Seat_Front_Driver#0`, `#1` and `GEO_Seat_Stitching_Front#0`; no transform, material or texture difference. - UVs, indices and vertex colours of the edited primitives are hash-identical, so the roughness-alpha thread mask still lines up (`tests/driver-seat-experiment.test.ts`). - Production SHA-256 values unchanged. Typecheck, lint, 64 unit tests, build and `npm run asset:gate` pass. Full report, rebuild steps and evidence list: `docs/3d-roadmap/3D-1_DRIVER_SEAT_EXPERIMENT.md`, `docs/evidence/3d-1/`. ## For the reviewer Deviations from `FIRST_IMPLEMENTATION_EXPERIMENT.md`: - Scripted reshaping of the decoded GLB, not Blender modelling. Re-running the full build would also have changed the passenger seat, which it mirrors from the driver seat. - No faces moved between insert and bolster, and no vertical channel seams. The insert uses a per-treatment baked atlas with no bake source; both need re-baked textures. - Cushion and headrest are unchanged, so Stitch Detail (aimed at the cushion) changes little: 1.1 % of stage pixels, against 2.1 % at Driver Hero. - The insert's outer edge moves up to 8 mm with fixed UVs, so the pattern stretches slightly there. - Driver and passenger backrests now differ, visible at Driver Hero and Cabin Pair. - The report corrects the earlier "sport-bucket" wording: measured bolsters stand about 0.04 m above the insert; the sporty look came mainly from the outline. Gallery photographs in `docs/evidence/3d-1/driver-hero-before-after-vs-08-30.jpg` are internal modelling references only. title: docs(reference-library): relabel the four pressroom images as exterior and correct interior claims that relied on them
body: ## Summary Documentation and filing only, inside `AUTOLAB_2020_LEXUS_RX350_REFERENCE_LIBRARY/`. No model, viewer, shader, UI, script or test file changes, and the three production GLBs are byte-identical to `main`. The four Lexus pressroom images in the first-round package were filed under `01_VEHICLE_INTERIOR/`, and three of them were indexed as the library's primary interior references. Direct inspection shows each is an exterior photograph with no usable view of the cabin: | File | Was indexed as | Actually shows | |---|---|---| | `2020_Lexus_RX_350_0049.jpg` | Official cockpit view | Silver RX, rear three-quarter view, on a city street | | `2020_Lexus_RX_350_0051.jpg` | Official centre-console view | Black RX driving, seen from above and behind | | `2020_Lexus_RX_350_0052.jpg` | Official front-cabin view | Silver RX, head-on front view, on a steel bridge | | `2020_Lexus_RX_Reveal.jpg` | Official reveal media, "broad cabin/exterior context" | Red RX, front three-quarter view, at an indoor reveal event; a second RX partly under a cover | **Changes** - The four files move from `01_VEHICLE_INTERIOR/{Cockpit,Centre_Console,Front_Seats}/` to a new `06_VEHICLE_EXTERIOR/`. They are 100 % git renames: the blob ids and SHA-256 values are unchanged, and no asset is deleted. `01_VEHICLE_INTERIOR/Cockpit/` is now empty. - `00_README/COLLECTION_OVERVIEW.md`: the three files leave the "highest-value primary references" list, a dated correction section covers all four, and the package map and "recommended use" text no longer point to them for interior work. - `05_RESEARCH_NOTES/VISUAL_REFERENCE_INDEX.md`: the four rows now say "Exterior only" and keep the old label for traceability. - `05_RESEARCH_NOTES/TECHNICAL_FINDINGS.md`: the pressroom bullet and implications 1 and 3 no longer treat the images as cockpit or console evidence. - `00_README/AUTOLAB_AI_3D_GENERATION_TECHNICAL_GUIDE_UPDATED.md` (lines 765–767): the three recommendations that cited "the official front-seat image" and "the official cockpit and console images" are corrected. The recommendations themselves stay. - `SECOND_RESEARCH_ROUND/agent_memos/04-centre-console.md` (lines 25 and 107): the three numbered images anchor model-year provenance only, not console appearance. The reference-board guidance now names the interior gallery photographs that do show the console (07, 19, 33, 34). - `00_README/SOURCE_AND_RIGHTS_REGISTER.csv`: `local_path`, `component` and `notes` corrected for the four rows. Source URL and rights fields are untouched. - `05_RESEARCH_NOTES/PACKAGE_MANIFEST.json`: the four paths updated and hashes refreshed; all 28 entries match the files on disk. - `SECOND_RESEARCH_ROUND/SECOND_ROUND_MANIFEST.json`: size and hash refreshed for its rights register (changed by #4) and for memo 04. Every prose correction is made in place with a dated note that keeps the original wording visible. The branch includes a merge of `main` (after #3 and #4). ## For the reviewer Remaining known issues, left on purpose: - `SECOND_ROUND_MANIFEST.json` lists itself with a hash. A file cannot contain its own hash, so that one entry never matches; it is unchanged. - `00_README/SOURCE_AND_RIGHTS_REGISTER.xlsx` is not updated; the CSV is the current record. - The byte-identical copies in `SECOND_RESEARCH_ROUND/source_assets/official_media/` are untouched. They sit in a neutral folder, and their register and manifest entries make no interior claim. title: docs(3d-roadmap): gallery-to-model reconciliation assessment and gallery rights record
body: ## Summary Documentation only. No file under `src/`, `public/`, `scripts/`, `blender/` or `tests/` changes, and the three production GLBs are byte-identical to `main`. **1. Assessment (owner-approved 2026-11-16)** in `docs/3d-roadmap/gallery-model-reconciliation/`: - `GALLERY_VISUAL_INDEX.md`: photo-by-photo index of Gallery 01–35 from direct inspection, plus the rest of the reference library. The Gallery 11 VIN is quoted only in masked form. - `MODEL_TO_PHOTO_RECONCILIATION.md`: component-by-component comparison of the shipped front-cabin model against the photographs. - `COMPONENT_GAP_ASSESSMENT.md`: ranking of the gaps. - `FIRST_IMPLEMENTATION_EXPERIMENT.md`: the driver-seat experiment, now marked approved but gated on #3 being merged. It has not started. - `EXECUTIVE_RECOMMENDATION.md`: findings, plus a new "Owner decisions recorded 2026-11-16" section. - `evidence/`: four model renders at the existing camera presets and four photo-against-model comparison sheets. **2. Gallery rights record** (owner statement, not independently verified): - New `AUTOLAB_2020_LEXUS_RX350_REFERENCE_LIBRARY/00_GALLERY_ORIGINALS/RIGHTS_AND_USE.md`. - `00_README/SOURCE_AND_RIGHTS_REGISTER.csv`: 35 new rows, one per photograph, each with its SHA-256 and pixel size. - `SECOND_RESEARCH_ROUND/SOURCE_AND_RIGHTS_REGISTER.csv`: one new row for the set. Recorded status: publicly accessible research photographs collected by a separate research agent, not AutoLab-owned. Photographer, source-specific licence and commercial reuse permission are unverified. Approved use is internal visual reference for modelling only. Customer-facing display, marketing use, redistribution and embedding in the commercial showroom are not approved. **3. Branding boundary:** the docs now state that no Lexus logo, badge, wordmark, emblem, branded screen or marketing artwork is reproduced, and that the steering-wheel centre stays neutral and unbranded. The reconciliation table no longer lists a missing hub emblem as a gap. ## For the reviewer - **This repository is public.** The gallery photographs, the Lexus pressroom images already on `main`, and the comparison sheets added here are therefore publicly readable. That does not fit the "redistribution not approved" rule recorded in this PR. Nothing was removed; the choice between making the repository private and moving the images out is the owner's. `RIGHTS_AND_USE.md` lists it as an open point. - `00_README/SOURCE_AND_RIGHTS_REGISTER.xlsx` is not updated. The CSV is the current record. - The two package manifests are not updated. Their hashes for both register CSVs were already out of date on `main`. - The separate PR that corrects the three exterior images (`0049`, `0051`, `0052`) touches other lines of the first-round register and does not conflict with this one. title: 3D-0: asset provenance, reproducibility report and working front-cabin gate
body: ## Summary 3D-0 only covers reproducibility and asset validation. No file under `src/` or `public/` changed. The shipped GLB hashes are pinned by a new test. **Finding:** the shipped `interior-l4-*.glb` are rebuilt by a committed chain in the original repo. That chain starts from three older GLBs at `fa3d62a`, not from the `.blend` files: ``` git show fa3d62a:interior-l4-*.glb -> prepare-front-cabin.mjs -> build_front_cabin.py (Blender 5.2.2) -> finalize-front-cabin.mjs (toktx UASTC + Draco + gate) ``` A Linux rebuild used Blender 5.2.2 and KTX 4.4.2, both checksum-verified, and ran in scratch only. It passes the gate and matches the shipped files in structure: same nodes, node transforms, material JSON, extensions, 66,260 triangles and 24 draw calls. It is **not byte-identical**: - 10 of 24 primitives are identical (seats and stitching). - Console and dashboard primitives keep the same vertex positions, but some triangles are split differently and some UV assignments differ. - Six textures differ by at most 20 of 255 levels. The Linux build is deterministic: two runs gave identical hashes. The report gives the full comparison, the provenance gaps and a recovery process that is proposed, not executed. **Validator (`scripts/validate-glb.mjs`)** - The default scope is now `lexus-front-cabin` (was `full`). `full` needed unmigrated S-Class files, which caused the "0 nodes" failure. - `assertScopeAvailable()` rejects `full` and `spike` with a clear message. - `--help` prints usage. - `npm run asset:gate` validates all three shipped GLBs. - Budgets are unchanged (80k triangles, 24 draw calls, 5 MB). **New `scripts/compare-glb.mjs`:** `compareGlbBytes(a, b)` reports: - byte identity; - node world-transform differences; - material differences (raw GLB material JSON with sorted keys, and texture indices replaced by names); - texture differences; - primitive differences, including an order-independent triangle hash at 0.1 mm that keeps face winding. **Tests:** - In-memory fixture mutations: over the triangle, draw-call or file-size budget, a renamed seat material, an extra node, a truncated shipped GLB, and refused S-Class scopes. - CLI tests. - Comparison-tool tests: a moved node, a changed material and reversed winding are each reported, and reordered material keys are not reported. - Pinned baseline hashes. Results: 58/58 unit tests pass; typecheck, lint, build and `asset:gate` (3 PASS) pass. **Docs and evidence:** - `docs/3d-roadmap/3D-0_REPRODUCIBILITY_REPORT.md` - `docs/evidence/3d-0/`: Driver Hero and Cabin Pair screenshots (desktop and mobile), the capture script and comparison JSON - `docs/STATE.md`, `docs/spike/cost-log.md` ![Driver Hero desktop](https://app.devin.ai/api/presigned_proxy?token=eyJhbGciOiJIUzI1NiIsInR5cCI6IkpXVCJ9..GBSmiYGVthTm_llwa3jp_9nyMTdqG6w0oPpdx1dDtzA) ![Cabin Pair desktop](https://app.devin.ai/api/presigned_proxy?token=eyJhbGciOiJIUzI1NiIsInR5cCI6IkpXVCJ9..P4bBWI0xsku3A7G6cHSOda7Ck8ia74PByjxonRKXGzw) Not reviewed: `scripts/*.mjs` are outside the repo's `eslint` scope, as before, and the existing validator already reports `process` no-undef there. title: docs(3d-roadmap): transition audit, Dilum technique research and 3D fidelity plan
body: ## Summary Documentation only, for owner approval: an audit of the move from `AUTOLAB-DIGITAL-SHOWROOM` and a proposed 3D development strategy. This PR changes no code, UI, viewer, GLB or Blender file. New files in `docs/3d-roadmap/`: - `DEVIN_TRANSITION_AUDIT.md`: exact commits (`b5338d3` original, `9f457a8` new), the fate of each original PR, byte-identical GLB hashes, the GLB node and material inventory, the new-repo baseline, and defects D1–D10 with root causes. - `DILUM_3D_TECHNIQUE_RESEARCH.md`: findings sorted into public-source evidence, creator claims and hypotheses, with a licence for each repo. - `LEXUS_FRONT_CABIN_FIDELITY_PLAN.md`: compares Blender, procedural and hybrid modelling. Recommends hybrid, with stages 3D-0 to 3D-6, budget estimates and validation. - `FULL_CABIN_EXPANSION_ROADMAP.md`: phases F1–F6 for doors, pillars, rear seats, headliner, starlight and full-cabin exploration. - `3D_MIGRATION_AND_COMPATIBILITY.md`: seven runtime contracts any new GLB must keep, the migration order and the swap/rollback procedure. Key findings a reviewer should check: - `scripts/validate-glb.mjs` fails here ("0 nodes"). Its default paths point at original-repo files that were never ported. - `hero_driver` is still the pre-PR #4 preset `[1.45, 1.25, 0.95]`. - The README of the master `.blend` lists material slots that are not in the shipped GLB, so the GLB cannot be rebuilt from committed sources yet. Baseline on `9f457a8` (Node 22.23.2): `npm ci`, typecheck, lint and build pass; vitest 39/39 pass. Playwright was not run. title: Integrate live 3D showroom, editorial atelier UI and expanded customization
body: ## Summary Transforms the existing prototype into a functioning AutoLab showroom demonstrator. - Integrates the real cabin viewer with KTX2/Draco assets and seven material bindings. - Adds three upholstery treatments, eight leather colours, accent-thread customization and two-tone composition. - Preserves four camera presets, loading/error states and Retry recovery. - Adds illustrative trim and ambient-light previews. - Introduces the editorial atelier landing, generated imagery and cinematic configuration flow. - Keeps the cabin visible during selection. - Fixes Back navigation and adds confirmation before resetting choices. - Updates the README, provenance, screenshots and verification reports. ## Validation - 39 unit tests passed. - Typecheck, lint and production build passed. - Recorded browser checks cover real material bindings, responsive layouts and recovery. - Latest desktop/mobile regression tests confirm Back preserves choices and Reset can be cancelled. ## Limitations - Independent demonstrator, not production acceptance. - Existing model shading and geometry limitations remain. - Physical-phone, Safari and hardware GPU testing remain open. - Generated imagery and sample finishes do not establish workshop availability. - Seven previously recorded moderate development-dependency findings remain unresolved. No production repository changes or deployment were performed. ---
